harness_reconciliation.issue: The executable printed ratios(5) as the median but accidentally used ratios(4) for the reduction line and speed-gate check.
harness_reconciliation.scientific_effect: The nine paired timing measurements and printed median are valid. Applying the preregistered rule to the actual median gives the same PASS classification.
harness_reconciliation.repair: F-AHL40R changes only reduction/gate indexing from sorted ratios(4) to ratios(5); workload and model implementation are unchanged.

finding: Under the frozen 16-authority serialized FMR workload, the stable-slot adaptive route preserves all fidelity gates and shows a robust median CPU reduction of about 4.55% relative to analytical hydraulics.
closure_rule_application: The binding-overhead micro-optimization subphase is scientifically complete. Do not open further micro-optimization work from timing noise alone.
nonclaims: No whole-SWAP or national MultiSWAP speedup is implied.
No parallel thread-safety claim is made.
No canonical production admission follows from this result alone.
